name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that transpiles a 5-qu
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that transpiles a 5-qubit random circuit (depth 12) to the basis gates ['rz','sx','x','cx'] with a line coupling map at optimization levels 0-3, printing depth and CX count for each level. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
